title: India-controlled data plane
decision: Keep originals, derivatives, inference, operators and recovery in approved Indian boundaries, with explicit export routes.
required_evidence: Inventory and observe every data/authority exit, support route and restore placement.

title: AI security and independent authority
decision: The LLM can propose but cannot create grants, approve actions or choose unrestricted tools/recipients.
required_evidence: Inject a malicious clause and prove no customer scope, action grant or export recipient changes.

title: AI governance and bank accountability
owners: Business, AI governance, legal and risk
decision: Approve purpose, dataset rights, risk tier, model limitations and acceptance evidence through named owners before onboarding.
required_evidence: Pin entity applicability and commencement; produce reviewed risk/evaluation/change records with unresolved gaps.

title: RAG security and document permissions
decision: Apply trusted grants before sparse/dense candidates and recheck parent expansion, cache, citations and display.
required_evidence: Deny cross-case probes, stale epochs, count/score leakage, parent expansion and cached answers after revocation.

title: Clause-aware legal chunking
decision: Use structured clause children with authorised parent/definition/exception expansion and page-coordinate citations.
required_evidence: Measure gold clause/context recall, amendment precedence, oversized-clause split and original-page hydration.

title: Hybrid retrieval with measured reranking
decision: Default the mixed archive to authorised hybrid retrieval; admit a bounded reranker only where paired gains justify cost and tail latency.
required_evidence: Compare BM25/dense/RRF/rerank on identical sealed queries; retain every per-query regression and language gap.

title: PII before embedding rerank and inference
decision: Use restricted extraction plus de-identification before general model paths; keep any OCR-original exception explicit and controlled.
required_evidence: Measure detector false negatives by era/script/image; confirm uncertain restricted content cannot bypass admission.

title: 70 percent cost target with quality gates
decision: Optimize complete cost per acceptable answer only after a paired baseline and predefined quality/safety noninferiority gates.
required_evidence: Record total cost, paired expert outcomes, adverse strata, abstention and privacy/material failures; independently accept.

title: Semantic cache with scoped reuse
decision: Cache only eligible low-risk answers inside matching subject/case/purpose/permission/corpus/release scope with freshness checks.
required_evidence: Track hit/total and hit/eligible; test epoch/release/entity changes, invalidation, expiry and grants on every hit.

title: Risk-based cheap and smart routing
decision: Route from verified task features, sufficient evidence and validated language; deny missing authority and escalate missing evidence.
required_evidence: Report cost and material errors by routed group, fallback count, deadline/budget and held-out selection bias.

title: Bounded tools and loop termination
decision: Use allowlisted schema-validated tools, independent grants, idempotent effects and cumulative step/cost/time budgets.
required_evidence: Force same-state loops, transient/permanent failures, timed-out writes, cancellation and denied action proposals.

title: Long-running memory is evidence not policy
decision: Separate session/task facts and durable verified memory; reauthorise and revalidate provenance/expiry on every resume.
required_evidence: Revoke a remembered source, restore an old snapshot, change purpose and test deletion/hold handling without leaks.

title: Schema-valid application JSON
decision: Return only independently validated answer envelopes or controlled error envelopes; separately validate citations and authorization.
required_evidence: Reject duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, unknown fields, denied citations, empty evidence and oversized output.

title: RAG before archive fine-tuning
decision: Keep changing customer facts in versioned authorised retrieval; use prompts for behaviour and consider narrow fine-tuning only for measured task gaps.
required_evidence: Compare retrieval/context versus behaviour failures; approve training rights and evaluate a fine-tune only with a defined gap.

title: Open-model batching KV and quantization
decision: Use admitted immutable models and measured batching/KV/quantization settings in approved placement, with online and ingest pools separated.
required_evidence: Publish actual hardware/model/engine/workload, latency/quality curves, saturation, cancellation and node-loss behaviour.

title: SSE safe output and disconnects
decision: Emit complete JSON events; distinguish progress from first safe answer; cancel or budget background work and reauthorise reconnect replay.
required_evidence: Test disconnect, expired cursor, revoked grant, proxy buffering, partial stream and idempotent run creation.

title: Trace each agent without raw PII
decision: Propagate root task scope/budget and child spans through all model/tool/retrieval/validation stages, storing protected payloads only by exception.
required_evidence: Reconstruct an approved synthetic run, nested retries, cancellation and asynchronous links; test trace ACL/redaction.

title: Compatible prompt rollback
owners: Release owner, model-risk and incident owner
decision: Deploy immutable prompt/model/schema/retrieval manifests behind a controlled alias and roll back to a compatible accepted release without restoring revoked permissions.
required_evidence: Canary a failing prompt; switch alias, invalidate caches, terminate/review old runs and measure recovery plus incident remediation.
